scripts.build: npm run build -w @cloud-harness/contracts && npm run build -w @cloud-harness/api && npm run build -w @cloud-harness/runner && npm run build -w @cloud-harness/api-key-gateway
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @cloud-harness/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @cloud-harness/api && npm run typecheck -w @cloud-harness/runner && npm run typecheck -w @cloud-harness/api-key-gateway
scripts.pages:preflight: npm run pages:check && node scripts/verify-pages-project.mjs && npm run pages:links
scripts.pages:deploy: npm run pages:preflight && wrangler pages deploy site --project-name cloud-harness-mcp --branch main && npm run pages:smoke
scripts.pages:list: wrangler pages deployment list --project-name cloud-harness-mcp --environment production --json
scripts.docs:preflight: npm run docs:artifact && node scripts/verify-docs-project.mjs && npm run docs:links
scripts.docs:deploy: npm run docs:reference && npm run docs:build && npm run docs:preflight && wrangler pages deploy docs-site/.vitepress/dist --project-name cloud-harness-docs --branch main && npm run docs:smoke
scripts.verify: npm run plugin:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
